head: Android Auto black screen: Google Maps not loading for some drivers
dek: Some Android Auto users report that Google Maps doesn't load when Android Auto starts, so the car's screen shows black where the map should be. Most reports come from Ford owners, and Google hasn't commented yet.
details: The problem shows up at random. In a second version of it, a black bar covers part of the map or the whole map area goes blank. Android Authority says it isn't clear whether only Ford cars are affected, and no phone models or Android versions are named. The fixes so far come from users and may only work for a while.
where: Some Android Auto users, most reports from Ford owners; no fix from Google yet
means: If your car's screen goes black when Android Auto opens Google Maps, you're not alone, and it may not be your phone or your car.
todo: Try what helped other drivers: tap your phone's screen to wake it, or switch to another screen on the car (one Ford driver used zone lighting) and back to Android Auto. If a black bar or blank map keeps coming back, clear the cache of Google Maps and Android Auto in your phone's app settings, then restart the phone.
thumb_words: ANDROID AUTO: GOOGLE MAPS GOES BLACK
